value_unit: finite HTTP follow-up budget and redirect recovery
decision_rationale: OkHttp makes follow-up budgeting explicit. LumiNet supplied CheckRedirect and thereby disabled net/http default redirect limits, so it reintroduces a target-owned finite budget plus loop rejection.
invariant: Every redirect is re-admitted and total follow-ups are finite.
negative_invariant: A cyclic or excessive chain cannot consume unbounded requests or bypass endpoint admission.

decision_rationale: Server retry hints improve cooperation, but untrusted origins cannot control availability indefinitely; LumiNet caps hints at 24h and takes max(backoff,hint).
invariant: Retry-After can only delay eligibility within a finite cap and never shortens local backoff.
negative_invariant: Malformed, past, negative, overflowed, or overlong hints cannot create unsafe duration behavior.

value_unit: TTL-scoped traceroute with per-hop repeated measurements
decision_rationale: mylg demonstrated actual TTL/path probing and hop statistics. LumiNet old code incremented TTL without applying it, so repeated TCP connects were mislabeled traceroute. A platform backend now emits truthful hop/loss/jitter/load-balance state.
invariant: A traceroute result is produced only from a real traceroute backend and bounded parsed hop observations.
negative_invariant: Missing backend is reported unsupported; URL/option-shaped targets and oversized options are rejected.

value_unit: temporal quality jitter as endpoint stability signal
decision_rationale: Peer samples include repeated latency/loss behavior. LumiNet retains real WireGuard handshake qualification and extracts only bounded temporal jitter, ranking loss then jitter then median RTT instead of importing arbitrary composite weights.
invariant: Repeated successful handshake RTT deltas contribute a deterministic stability discriminator.
negative_invariant: Jitter never overrides reachability or loss and does not expand concurrency/attempt bounds.

value_unit: longest-prefix lookup independent of corpus cardinality
decision_rationale: BART supplies strong LPM evidence. LumiNet keeps Go ownership and rederives a fixed-width immutable prefix index, preserving priority/stable-tie semantics while eliminating full-corpus scans.
invariant: Most-specific prefix wins; identical-prefix priority and stable tie behavior match the previous linear reference.
negative_invariant: Indexing cannot change provider attribution relative to the validated reference semantics.

value_unit: IPv4 declared-total-length validation and exact payload slicing
decision_rationale: libcrafter rejects total_length<header and actual<truncated declared length and slices payload to the declaration. LumiNet Rust parser previously trusted IHL but could accept truncated or trailing bytes.
invariant: IPv4 total length must cover the header and be present before payload is exposed.
negative_invariant: Trailing bytes after declared total length are not reclassified as IP payload.

value_unit: IPv6 declared-payload-length validation and exact slicing
decision_rationale: libcrafter validates 40+payload_length before decoding. LumiNet now rejects truncated declarations and excludes trailing bytes from payload.
invariant: IPv6 payload length must be fully present before payload is exposed.
negative_invariant: Trailing bytes beyond declared payload length are not part of the parsed payload.

decision_rationale: libcrafter makes incomplete-flow bounds, maximum datagram size, age and conflicting-overlap policy explicit. LumiNet old append/sort reassembly was unbounded by flow count and could misassemble overlaps.
invariant: Reassembly is offset-aware, bounded by age/flow/datagram size, and completes only with full byte coverage plus offset-zero header and final length.
negative_invariant: Conflicting overlap, inconsistent final length, invalid alignment, and bytes beyond final length discard the ambiguous flow.

decision_rationale: Passive visibility and enrichment are useful operator evidence, but process termination/firewall actions would be unsafe without a canonical cross-runtime flow authority and explicit per-operation authorization.
invariant: A future connection view must be read from one authoritative cross-runtime flow ledger.
negative_invariant: UI-local or sniffer-local state cannot claim universal active connections or authorize process termination.

decision_rationale: The UX is valuable, but Yacd assumes a backend /connections authority. LumiNet engine-local session maps are partial and cannot truthfully back a universal connection page.
invariant: Connection UX must be downstream of one canonical flow ledger with runtime ownership and close semantics.
negative_invariant: No partial engine/session map may be presented as all LumiNet connections.

value_unit: desktop connection/process listing and per-process affordances
decision_rationale: Throne reinforces the value of process-aware connection UX, but desktop per-app routing is not an existing LumiNet authority and must not be smuggled in through UI plumbing.
invariant: Process attribution must have one target-owned observation source and truthful platform support state.
negative_invariant: Desktop per-app/process controls remain unsupported until a canonical enforcement owner exists.

value_unit: atomic checkpoint save plus scheduler snapshot/dedup restore
decision_rationale: Atomic temp-to-replace checkpoints are sound for replay-safe work, but generic resume would conflict with LumiNet jobs whose side effects may not be idempotent. Existing restart-fails-running behavior remains until job types explicitly declare checkpoint-safe replay semantics.
invariant: Automatic resume requires a typed idempotency/checkpoint contract, not merely serialized queue state.
negative_invariant: Queued/running jobs are not silently replayed after daemon restart.

decision_rationale: Subconverter confirms URL-safe base64, SSR, SIP002 and multi-format edge cases, but LumiNet already has bounded native protocol parsers plus observed-form contract tests and should keep one profile parser authority.
invariant: Observed external forms normalize into one target ProxyConfig contract.
negative_invariant: No embedded scripting/converter service gains profile authority.

decision_rationale: Validating generated configs with the actual runtime is a useful oracle, but AGPL source and a second sing-box process/subscription authority are not integrated. LumiNet retains target-native compatibility validation and can use runtime differential checks only in compatible release environments.
invariant: Compatibility claims require either explicit target validation rules or an external runtime oracle in verification, not silent coercion.
negative_invariant: AGPL donor runtime ownership is not embedded into LumiNet.

decision_rationale: LumiNet already owns bounded WARP candidate generation, repeated real handshakes, loss/jitter/median ranking and MASQUE/WireGuard runtime seams. Donor process/runtime ownership would duplicate authority.
invariant: Qualification remains bounded and based on actual target-owned handshake probes.
negative_invariant: No donor WARP process or unbounded scan queue becomes authoritative.

decision_rationale: The donor reinforces pluggable fetchers and cancellation, but LumiNet already has bounded scanner scheduling, typed diagnostics, liveness checks, and target-owned cancellation.
invariant: Scanner work remains bounded, cancellable and typed under LumiNet ownership.
negative_invariant: No JVM scanner framework or plugin authority is added.

decision_rationale: Netmon has strong lifecycle semantics, including interface removal and default-route changes, but adding a cross-platform route observer is a new supervision plane. The existing Android underlay tracker remains the only shipped underlay surface in this wave.
invariant: Any future netmon plane must have explicit ownership, event ordering, removal reconciliation and no competing route mutation authority.
negative_invariant: Observation cannot silently become route mutation or keep radios/networks acquired.

decision_rationale: The mechanism requires raw packet injection and GPL source. LumiNet already has an evasion authority with safety bounds; adding a second raw injector would amplify privileges and create conflicting packet mutation ownership.
invariant: Raw packet mutation must remain behind one bounded target-owned evasion authority.
negative_invariant: A peer raw injector cannot gain independent live network authority.

value_unit: raw fake-TCP/SNI injection plus service deployment
decision_rationale: The Pro variant combines privileged injection with deployment/service controls, increasing blast radius. LumiNet retains its existing bounded evasion plane instead.
invariant: Live packet mutation and service lifecycle authority stay separately bounded and target-owned.
negative_invariant: Peer deployment automation cannot implicitly authorize raw injection.

decision_rationale: The scheme explicitly provides weak anti-scanning rather than strong authentication and uses legacy SHA1 iteration. Forking an obsolete OpenSSH transport would degrade crypto/runtime ownership.
invariant: SSH compatibility/security follows current target runtime/provider contracts, not legacy protocol forks.
negative_invariant: Weak obfuscation must never be described or used as authentication.

decision_rationale: LumiNet is not adopting tenant/reseller/server-admin authority; doing so would add identities, quotas, server mutation and a second Xray source of truth unrelated to the client control model.
invariant: Server tenant/admin state cannot become LumiNet client authority by peer convergence alone.
negative_invariant: No reseller/quota/server-admin subsystem is copied.

decision_rationale: A new identity provider would be a major authentication authority outside the requested client/network convergence and conflicts with existing product trust boundaries.
invariant: Identity authority changes require an explicit product/security migration, not opportunistic donor adoption.
negative_invariant: No OIDC IdP becomes embedded or authoritative in this wave.

decision_rationale: LumiNet uses React/Wails and Kotlin mobile surfaces; GTK generator adoption would add a second UI technology without semantic product value.
invariant: UI framework additions must serve a target product requirement and preserve one coherent design/state model.
negative_invariant: No parallel GTK product surface or generated binding tree is added.

decision_rationale: The data is untrusted, rapidly stale, externally scraped, and the archive has no clear root license. LumiNet may parse user-authorized sources but will not ship peer-collected endpoints as trusted profiles.
invariant: Remote proxy data is admitted only through explicit target-owned source validation and freshness/health state.
negative_invariant: Peer datasets never become built-in authoritative endpoints.
